2608.28407.title: A Unified Framework to Elicit Structured Feedback for Interpretable Multi-Trait Essay Scoring
2608.28407.paper_summary: Multi-trait Automated Essay Scoring (AES) requires rubric-grounded reasoning across interdependent traits, rather than isolated score prediction. Existing feedback-enhanced methods often decouple feedback from scoring or assess traits independently, weakening score--feedback consistency and rubric alignment. We propose HiFTS, a unified autoregressive framework that generates hierarchical CoT feedback before predicting trait-level and holistic scores. HiFTS distills rubric-grounded hierarchical CoT feedback from a teacher LLM and trains student models to jointly generate feedback and scores. HiFTS further applies Group Relative Policy Optimization with a composite reward balancing score agreement, calibration, feedback quality, and structural validity. At inference, a lightweight global prior provides holistic guidance to reduce drift during long-form reasoning. We also introduce CFMS-34, a Chinese multi-trait AES dataset with 951 essays annotated with holistic scores and 34 rubric-based traits. Experiments on CFMS-34 and ASAP++ show that HiFTS achieves strong holistic and trait-level scoring while producing coherent, rubric-aligned feedback.
2608.28407.paper_summary_zh: 多特徵自動化論文評分（AES）需要基於評分標準的推理，涉及相互依賴的特徵，而不是孤立的分數預測。現有的增強反饋方法通常將反饋與評分分開，或獨立評估特徵，這削弱了分數與反饋的一致性和評分標準的對齊。我們提出了HiFTS，一個統一的自回歸框架，該框架在預測特徵層級和整體分數之前生成分層的CoT反饋。HiFTS從教師LLM中提煉基於評分標準的分層CoT反饋，並訓練學生模型共同生成反饋和分數。HiFTS進一步應用群體相對策略優化，使用綜合獎勵來平衡分數一致性、校準、反饋質量和結構有效性。在推理階段，一個輕量級的全局先驗提供整體指導，以減少長篇推理過程中的漂移。我們還介紹了CFMS-34，一個包含951篇論文的中文多特徵AES數據集，這些論文標註了整體分數和34個基於評分標準的特徵。在CFMS-34和ASAP++上的實驗顯示，HiFTS在產生一致且符合評分標準的反饋的同時，實現了強大的整體和特徵層級評分。
